title.narrative: Sustainable Food and Nutrition Security in Red Sea State (SFNS-RSS)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the SFNS-RSS project is for smallholder agro-pastoralist households in Agig, Haya, Dordeib, Tokar and Sinkat to have sustainably improved Food and Nutrition Security. The following 2 outcomes (results) will contribute to its achievement: Improved agricultural productivity, climate resilience and food and nutrition security; Improved safe water supply and hygiene practices.A focus on women’s economic and social empowerment will be achieved as a cross-cutting issue and directly with the partnership of Abuhadia Society for Women and Community Development (ASWCD). The overall objective and outcomes will be achieved by a multi-sectorial approach implementing the following activities:

The project supports the target groups to achieve sustainable food and nutrition security. SFNS-RSS will increase and diversify agricultural productivity and food and nutrition security through climate-resilient agricultural practices. Next to the specific promotion for Women Economic Activities the project mainstreams gender and women's rights sensitization. Trainings and the rehabilitation or establishment of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) infrastructure are the second tier of SFNS-RSS and will result in better access to water and improved hygiene practices. A Covid-19 component forms part of the project to promote awareness and resources for infection prevention and control alongside the regular hygiene promotion.
